response.sql: WITH circuit_stats AS (SELECT circuitId, AVG(round) AS average_round, COUNT(*) AS race_count FROM races GROUP BY circuitId), ranked AS (SELECT circuitId, average_round, race_count, 1.0 * race_count / SUM(race_count) OVER () AS race_share, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY race_count DESC) AS share_rank FROM circuit_stats) SELECT circuitId, average_round, race_count, race_share FROM ranked WHERE share_rank <= 10 ORDER BY race_share DESC, circuitId;
